entries.observed_pattern: 2024-09-05 developer release notes: hide long shop descriptions when they obscure held skills; add keyboard/gamepad map prompts.

entries.observed_pattern: Historical early-access FAQ separates controller support from absent remapping, combines tactics with animated combat and iterative community feedback.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Test the actual input path; controller support alone is not accessibility proof. Historical FAQ is not current feature inventory.
entries.do_not_copy: No deck, hand or momentum rule adoption.

entries.observed_pattern: 2024-12-13 beta and later release: larger UI, bounded panels, directional menu navigation; asks players to test despite Deck verification.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Visible focusable controls and real input tests; machine verification remains separate from people.
entries.do_not_copy: No enemy intent disclosure or rewind rule adoption.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: Advanced Edition FAQ offers a pre-run additional-content toggle while noting some balance changes still apply. Page includes contradictory historical platform/language entries.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Make control scope explicit: our switches affect presentation only. Treat undated historical FAQ carefully; no audio claim inferred.
entries.do_not_copy: No full-intent forecast or grid rules.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: 2025 developer updates distinguish delivered fixes from future UI/accessibility roadmap and incorporate feedback.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Separate implemented controls from future settings persistence; do not label roadmap as shipped.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: 2022-10-14 senior UX interview: camera shake toggle, sound categories, directional menus and accessibility designed early.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Reuse existing sound and motion handlers, maintain semantic output without sound.
entries.do_not_copy: No invulnerability, difficulty or auto-targeting changes.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: Official changelog: screen shake options, menu rebinding, removal of conflicting fixed restart shortcut.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Discoverable controls and focus traversal instead of new hard-coded hotkeys.
entries.do_not_copy: No movement physics, assist difficulty or art.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: Developer support distinguishes settings file from progress save and documents platform-specific controller issues.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Preserve progress schema; persistence is a separate future preference-lifecycle slice, not bundled into this visibility repair.
entries.do_not_copy: No save-file reset performed; no action-game mechanics.
entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.

entries.observed_pattern: Developer support describes master/music/speech/SFX/UI volume and transferring accessible features between games.
entries.project_fit_and_difference: Reuse existing UI/SFX components, adapt only the available SFX consumer.

entries.reaction_or_gap: Developer/public documentation only; no representative player outcome or private implementation evidence.
